blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval wooden market stall featuring a sloped striped awning in alternating maroon and forest green. The stall has four sturdy timber uprights supporting a canopy frame and a front wooden display counter. On the counter are various goods including two brass lanterns, a stack of straw hats, a carved wooden figurine, a small standing mirror, strings of beads or garlic, and pillar candles. In front on the ground sits a wooden crate filled with a wrapped box and round produce (fruit and vegetables). All surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled in a stylized hand-painted game art aesthetic, with no floating parts or defects.
blind.from_above: A rectangular striped red-and-green awning traversed by a top wooden ridge pole, with wooden post tops visible at the corners and the front display edge and crate protruding below.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5.0 feet wide across the posts.
